label: president or manager of
definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or institution Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the earlier combined president/manager scope. Explicit historical office qualifies. Generic leader, running/control, director, chairman, founder, owner, coach or athlete leadership alone does not establish either specified office. Manager cases are marked as the deliberately broader role family.

facts.reason: Accorsi is explicitly Giants manager in possessive, of and noun-modifier constructions.
Herzog is explicitly Cardinals manager in both rows.
Grunfeld is explicitly Knicks president and manager; director wording alone would be insufficient.
Cashen is explicitly Mets manager and president.
Phillips is explicitly Mets manager; the director row expresses another role.
